headline.zh: 阿里通義千問發布 Qwen 3.8 27B FP8 量化權重
headline.en: Alibaba Releases Qwen 3.8 27B FP8 Quantized Weights

detail.zh: Qwen 3.8 系列推出 27B 參數規模的 FP8 native 量化版本，極大地降低了中型 LLM 在單卡 GPU 上的推論門檻。開發者現可直接在 Hugging Face 下載權重進行本機部署與微調。
detail.en: The Qwen 3.8 family introduces a 27B parameter FP8 natively quantized version, drastically lowering GPU VRAM requirements for single-card inference. Developers can download weights directly on Hugging Face.

headline.zh: DeepSeek API 推出離峰時段優惠計價機制
headline.en: DeepSeek API Introduces Off-Peak Discounted Pricing

detail.zh: DeepSeek 官方更新 API 計價政策，引入尖峰與離峰時間動態價格。對於非即時性批次任務或異步處理的開發者而言，善用離峰時段可大幅降低 API 呼叫成本。
detail.en: DeepSeek officially updated its API pricing model to feature peak and off-peak dynamic rates. Developers running batch processing or async tasks can leverage off-peak hours to cut API costs significantly.

headline.zh: 面對中國低價模型逼近，OpenAI 與 Anthropic 掀起 API 價格戰
headline.en: OpenAI and Anthropic Enter Price War as Chinese AI Rivals Gain Ground

detail.zh: 受 DeepSeek 等高性價比模型進逼，美系 AI 巨頭紛紛下調輕量級與主力 API 價格。這意味著開發者構建 Agent 和大規模 LLM 應用的 Token 成本將進一步暴跌。
detail.en: Pressure from cost-effective models like DeepSeek has driven US AI leaders to slash API prices for lightweight and flagship models, further reducing token costs for agentic workflows.

headline.zh: 標籤分類新思路：讓 LLM 自由幻覺，再搭配向量比對
headline.en: A New Tagging Strategy: Let LLMs Hallucinate, Then Map via Embeddings

detail.zh: 當已有標籤庫龐大無法全放入 Prompt 時，可讓模型先發揮『想像』產生語意標籤，再利用 Vector Embedding 找尋資料庫中最接近的既有 Tag，兼具彈性與精準度。
detail.en: Instead of feeding thousands of existing tags into a prompt, let the LLM generate unconstrained ideal tags, then use vector embeddings to match them against your existing taxonomy.

headline.zh: Hugging Face 發布 2026 夏季開源模型現狀報告
headline.en: Hugging Face Releases Summer 2026 State of Open Models Report

detail.zh: 報告指出開放權重模型在 10B-30B 級距的效能已追平前代閉源旗艦，且端側推理與 FP8/INT4 量化生態正在快速成熟，獨立開發者的自我託管能力顯著增強。
detail.en: The report highlights that open-weight models in the 10B-30B parameter range now match previous closed-source flagships, with edge inference and FP8/INT4 ecosystems rapidly maturing.

headline.zh: 剖析 AI 文字浮水印原理：Logits 採樣中的隱形機制
headline.en: Understanding AI Text Watermarking: Invisible Signals in Logits Sampling

detail.zh: 本文深度解析生成式 AI 如何在 Logits 採樣階段將特定隨機數序列寫入生成的 Token 流中，實現不影響閱讀體驗又能高精準度檢測 LLM 內容的機制。
detail.en: A deep dive into how generative AI embeds subtle pseudo-random signals during logits sampling, enabling precise LLM text detection without degrading readability.

headline.zh: Anthropic 發布 Claude Code 開發會話最佳化指南
headline.en: Anthropic Shares Guide on Maximizing Claude Code Session Efficiency

detail.zh: 官方點出多數工程師使用 Claude Code 遇到的 Token 浪費問題，並提供 Context 管理、跨會話記憶保持與精確 Prompt 拆解的最佳實踐。
detail.en: Anthropic shares best practices to avoid token waste in Claude Code, focusing on effective context management, cross-session memory preservation, and task decomposition.

headline.zh: Google Gemini 開放關閉生成圖片與影片的可視水印
headline.en: Google Allows Disabling Visible Watermarks on Gemini Generations

detail.zh: 使用者現可在 Gemini 與 Flow 中關閉右下角的可視水印，但此舉不會影響檔案內部嵌入的 SynthID 隱形 AI 浮水印與驗證機制。
detail.en: Users can now toggle off the visible sparkle watermark in Gemini and Flow image/video outputs without affecting background SynthID invisible watermarking.

headline.zh: Writer 基於 GLM-5.2 推出新模型，著眼降低企業 Token 成本
headline.en: Writer Introduces New Model Built on GLM-5.2 to Contain Token Costs

detail.zh: Writer 以 Z.ai 開源的 GLM-5.2 為基礎進行後訓練，並結合升級的 Harness 框架，協助企業在保持推論品質的同時壓縮代碼與文字生成開銷。
detail.en: Built as a post-training variation on GLM-5.2, Writer's new system pairs with an upgraded harness to deliver production-ready capabilities at significantly lower token costs.

headline.zh: Google 展示全同態加密用於隱私 AI 推論的實務進展
headline.en: Google Demonstrates Practical Homomorphic Encryption for Private AI

detail.zh: Google 開源其同態加密 (FHE) 技術最新成果，能在完全不解密用戶敏感資料的情況下完成 LLM 推算，大幅邁向隱私安全計算的實用化階段。
detail.en: Google detailed its latest practical progress in Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE), enabling LLM inference on encrypted data without ever exposing sensitive plaintext.

headline.zh: 初創公司 Kog 突破 GPU 限制，優化 Agent 導向的推論效率
headline.en: Startup Kog Optimizes GPU Architecture to Boost Agentic Inference Efficiency

detail.zh: 法國新創 Kog 針對 Agent 多輪互動與頻繁上下文切換的特性，重新架構 GPU 推論記憶體管理，挑戰 GPU 不適合 Agent 工作流的傳統迷思。
detail.en: French startup Kog is re-architecting GPU memory and execution pipelines to drastically improve inference throughput for context-heavy agentic workflows.

headline.zh: Apple 據報與阿里巴巴合作為中國市場訓練專屬 AI 模型
headline.en: Apple Reportedly Trains Custom China AI Model with Alibaba

detail.zh: 為符合中國地緣法規與監管要求，蘋果與阿里巴巴合作開發適用於中國境內 Apple Intelligence 的專屬模型，展現美中科技分流下的折衷策略。
detail.en: To satisfy local regulatory constraints, Apple partnered with Alibaba to co-train a China-specific LLM for Apple Intelligence features in the domestic market.

headline.zh: Meta 推出可自託管的 Glimmer 開源權重模型
headline.en: Meta Releases Self-Hostable Open-Weight Model Glimmer

detail.zh: 扎克伯格重申 AI 屬於所有人，釋出可於本機硬體運行的 Glimmer 開源模型，但同時將更強大的 Muse Spark 保留為 API 獨佔模式。
detail.en: Meta released Glimmer as an open-weight model executable on local hardware, while reserving its higher-tier Muse Spark model behind proprietary APIs.

headline.zh: 自辦訴訟原告懷疑法官使用 AI 審案，在起訴書中注入 Prompt 試圖操控判決
headline.en: Pro se litigant injects prompt injections into court filings suspecting judge uses AI

headline.zh: 微軟 Copilot 語音模式宣布退役黃色膠囊吉祥物 Mico
headline.en: Microsoft retires Mico avatar from Copilot Voice mode

headline.zh: Simon Willison 發布 sqlite-utils 4.2.1 修復依賴套件崩潰 Bug
headline.en: Simon Willison releases sqlite-utils 4.2.1 to fix dependency crash

headline.zh: 預測顯示天然氣價格暴漲，或加重超大規模 AI 資料中心能耗成本
headline.en: Natural gas price spike forecast threatens to hike hyperscaler AI data center costs
